Name: Owljoy's Plushies CP
Author: OwlandJoy
Description:
What's Included:
This mod adds the following 10 plushies to the game:
[list]
[*]Blubi, Mochi, Beri, Octi, Bloop[/*]
[*]Enderman, Flitti, Snek, Twinkly, Toffee[/*]
[/list]How to use:
[list]
[*][b]Placement:[/b] These plushies can be placed on floors, tables, and other surfaces.[/*]
[*][b]Acquisition:[/b] You can purchase all of these plushies from [b]Robin[/b] at the Carpenter's Shop.[/*]
[*][b]Cheat/Debug:[/b] Don't want to wait to buy them? You can use an item spawner mod (like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url]) to add them to your inventory instantly.[/*]
[/list]Requirements:
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/*]
[/list]Installation:
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI and Content Patcher.[/*]
[*]Download the mod file.[/*]
[*]Unzip the folder and place the
[code][CP] Owljoy's Plushies[/code]folder into your game's
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game using SMAPI![/*]
[/list][i]If you enjoy this mod, consider supporting my work here: [url=https://ko-fi.com/owljoy]https://ko-fi.com/owljoy[/url][/i]

Downloads.Description: Initial release of Owljoy's Plushies. Adds several new plushie items to the game.
